RAISED to 482 KiB (493,568 B) on 2026-08-26 for the machine-identity campaign (GIT_86, #76), and unlike the third raise, this one WAS measured first. The eleven-task campaign put the tree 7,966 B over the 483,328 B ceiling - measured 491,294 B raw. Per-module sourcemap attribution (77c4823 vs dd0d454) accounted for exactly 9,946 B of gross growth, matching the real build to within sourcemap-comment overhead, and both obvious results.ts-style split candidates were tested and falsified before raising, not assumed. config/migrateStorage.ts's v2->v3 legacy migration looks structurally identical to the results.ts precedent, but createConfigStore() calls it SYNCHRONOUSLY inside loadPersonCache(), and test/config-migrate-v3.test.ts asserts the migrated config is on store.config immediately after construction with no await - a dynamic import would show a legacy user un-migrated defaults on first render. Reusable insight: a synchronous-construction contract forecloses import() no matter how separable the code looks by inspection. config/parse.ts's 'v2 arm' is one line reusing the same parseOverlay the always-eager v3 branch calls, and parseOverlay/parseOverlayPayload run synchronously on every boot via the localStorage person-cache read, not only behind the awaited SD download - there is no v2-only validation left to peel off into its own module. The one genuinely deferrable piece, readStampedMachineOverlay/stampMachineOverlay, is reached only from async connector paths, but loadFromMachine runs on EVERY connect for EVERY user, so moving it behind import() would add an HTTP request to RRF's weak embedded server on the universal connect path to recover only ~300-500 B of the 7,966 B gap. Reusable insight: a fix that trades a request on the universal connect path for headroom is not a fix, it is CLAUDE.md's first hard constraint traded for a fifth of the gap, and that trade is wrong regardless of how small the recovered headroom is. Attribution shape: distributed plumbing, no single culprit, no eager-module-reaching-into-lazy-subsystem pattern, no results.ts-style shape-vs-format split anywhere in the diff. Largest single contributor is config/store.ts at +2,731 B (nine rung-6 choke points, all boot-synchronous or on the universal connect path); six new modules add +4,493 B (migrateStorage +1,218, machineIdentityText +1,051, SystemCards +873, machineId +728, machineStore +402, machineSession +221); the remainder is spread thin across roughly 16 files. This entry is NOT licence to raise again: if a future measurement finds a single module carrying both a synchronous shape and a deferrable format, or an eager module reaching into a lazy subsystem, that is still the fix, and citing this entry instead would repeat the third raise's mistake. The attribution also surfaced a standing architectural cost that PREDATES this campaign and is NOT fixed here: every card is eager, so every new card costs eager bytes permanently - making cards lazy is the structural fix and remains undone. Do not trust this headroom figure later - measure.
